blocks.tamil_translation: that leads to arrogance? Or are you waiting for an illness that disables? Or are you waiting for old age that takes away the mind? Or are you waiting for death that comes suddenly? (At times one does not even get the chance to make Tawbah.) Are you waiting for the coming of Dajjal, the worst of hidden evils? Or are you waiting for the coming of the Day of Qiyamah? That is more severe and most bitter.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- Before any one of these seven things occurs, a person should make preparation for the Hereafter through good deeds. If any one of these things occurs, it may become impossible to do good deeds.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَتْبَعُ الْمَيِّتَ ثَلَاثَةٌ، فَيَرْجِعُ اثْنَانِ وَيَبْقَي وَاحِدٌ، يَتْبَعُهُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعَمَلُهُ، فَيَرْجِعُ أَهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ، وَيَبْقَي عَمَلُهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Three things follow the deceased; two of them return, and only one stays with the dead body: his relatives, his wealth and his deeds. His relatives and wealth return, and then only his deeds stay with him.” Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرٍو ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَطَبَ يَوْماً فَقَالَ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ: أَلَا إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا عَرَضٌ حَاضِرٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا الْبَرُّ وَالْفَاجِرُ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ اْلآخِرَةَ أَجَلٌ صَادِقٌ يَقْضِي فِيهَا مَلِكٌ قَادِرٌ، أَلَا وَإِنَّ الْخَيْرَ كُلَّهُ بِحَذَافِيرِهِ
